products.name: Wrapping Paper
products.description: Wrap your gifts in style and make every moment extra special! Our custom wrapping paper adds a fun, personal touch with unique designs that bring joy to any occasion. Perfect for birthdays, holidays, or just because you want to. Turn every gift into a delightful surprise they'll love!

products.name: Water Activated Tapes
products.description: Wondering what length you need for your water activated tape? We offer rolls in 100 ft. and 300 ft. This gives you the flexibility to use multiple rolls when applying by hand or use one big roll with a tape dispenser for high-volume application.

products.name: Standard Shipping Boxes
products.description: Protection is the name of the game here and corrugated custom shipping boxes are the star player. These boxes are the most economical choice for shipping bulkier items. They're thick, strong, and secure without skimping on style.

products.name: Stand Up Pouches
products.description: Even if the gussets for stand-up pouches expand, it’s still a best practice to use packaging that fits perfectly. We offer a wide range of pouch sizes that present your products in the best manner possible.

products.name: Rigid Mailers
products.description: Safeguard your shipments with tough, lightweight custom rigid mailers that keep contents flat and pristine. Choose from gloss, matte, or high-gloss UV coatings with sturdy 16 pt. cardstock option. Perfect for mailing photos, prints, documents, or flat promotional materials.

products.name: Poly Tapes
products.description: Standard sized poly tapes are thick by themselves at 2”, but if you need it thicker, a 3” option is available. This offers more surface area for your logo design and for package support.

products.name: Pillow Boxes
products.description: Ill-fitting boxes make us sad. If your product doesn’t fit any of our standard sizing options, go custom! Our custom size option helps you provide a perfect fit for your products, ensuring they won’t shift while in transit.

products.name: Custom Mailer Box
products.description: Go for a stylish and sturdy custom mailer box designed to ship directly in the mail. Choose between black ink or colored printing to suit your brand. Perfect for retail-ready gift boxes, subscription boxes, and e-commerce packaging. Need something different? You can check out our customizableShipping BoxesandProduct Boxesfor your different packaging needs!

products.name: Hanging Tab Boxes
products.description: We offer popular hanging product box sizes as standard, but you also have the option to go the custom route. Getting the perfect fit is crucial as presentation plays a key factor in a customer’s positive experience with your brand.

products.name: Flat Pouches
products.description: Whether you’re shipping food sauces, dry flour, or perishable food items, there’s a flat pouch that fits the bill. We offer a wide range of standard pouch sizes that can accommodate most items. These conform to the size of your products and can expand a bit when needed.

products.name: Econoflex Shipping Boxes
products.description: Made from 100% recycled and recyclable materials, Econoflex is the most eco-friendly shipping box available today (it’s even biodegradable). Econoflex shippers are perfect for deliveries of all kinds. New for 2020, these elegantly minimalist shipping boxes set the standard for sustainable packaging with a trifecta of print quality rivaling Flexo, speedy turnaround, and affordable pricing.

products.name: Custom Tissue Papers
products.description: Custom tissue paper comes in four different sizes: 10” x 15", 15” x 20”, 17” x 23”, and 20" x 30". Choose a smaller size for lining boxes and a bigger one for wrapping or void fill.

products.name: Corrugated Product Boxes
products.description: Don’t settle for anything less than a perfect fit. Using product boxes with the right size makes your products look more professional and elevates the customer experience.

products.name: Cardstock Product Boxes
products.description: Flex your branding muscle on retail shelves and in subscription sets alike with cardstock product boxes. These boxes are lightweight, durable, and print with vibrantly-colored images. They can be assembled in seconds and are ideal packaging for supplements, cosmetics, or wellness products.

products.name: Book Shipping Boxes
products.description: Safeguard each story before it’s told. Our customizable, corrugated cardboard book shipping boxes are easy to assemble and have enhanced bottom strength to support heavy books and documents. These boxes are available in standard and custom sizes and can be printed on all sides. Use our online design tool to create unique artwork that stands out.
